themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents designed to autonomously perform research tasks, including data collection, analysis, and strategy.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Focuses on the discovery, comparison, and application of various AI-powered tools for research processes.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Explores AI tools that assist developers in writing, reviewing, and debugging code, accelerating the software development lifecycle.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Investigates how AI is affecting job markets, including potential job displacement, creation, and the changing nature of work.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Details how AI is integrated into the design process, from ideation and prototyping to generating design assets and informing research.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Covers AI applications focused on condensing large amounts of text, such as meeting notes, transcripts, and research papers, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Involves the comparison and evaluation of different AI-powered tools for specific research functionalities.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Examines the research into the capabilities, limitations, ethical implications, and user interactions with AI chatbots.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of AI-generated user profiles and data for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Focuses on AI applications that enhance the creation, distribution, and analysis of surveys and polls.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
